user.title: Scene Toggle Setup
user.description: Configure a scene toggle group. This will create three entities based on the name you provide: a sensor showing the current scene, and buttons to switch to the next/previous scene.

data_description.name: A short name for this scene group (e.g., "living_room" or "office"). Only lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores are allowed. This will create the following entities: sensor.scene_toggle_[name]_current_scene, button.scene_toggle_[name]_next_scene, button.scene_toggle_[name]_previous_scene.
data_description.scenes: Select scenes in the order you want to cycle through them.
data_description.wrap_around: When enabled, pressing Next on the last scene jumps to the first scene, and pressing Previous on the first scene jumps to the last. When disabled, the buttons do nothing at the ends of the list.

error.no_scenes: No scenes available. Create at least one scene first.
error.name_required: Please enter a name for this scene group.
error.name_invalid: Name can only contain lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores.

abort.already_configured: This scene set is already configured.
